notes.title: U27RA R3Z0NANC3 - Developer Live Stream, Pounce Two
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1413670/extras/Defy_your_meowsteny.gif?t=1612339548[/img]

U27RA R3Z0NANC3 is a retrowave, sokoban-like, puzzle game about a cat in search of The Truth.

You play as a cute cat called Neko. He is trying to reach “Zawarodu End’s™” and find some answers to what “The Truth” is while his overprotective brother, Wevil, is trying to stop him with exaggeratedly complicated puzzle traps. The game is filled with extremely edgy jokes, interesting situations, curious mechanics and good retro inspired music.

The developer for this game will try his best to remember how to finish his own levels. We will try together to survive through some very edgy dialogues and explore what is so curious about these retrowave cats!
